# Claim Boundary

## Permitted claims
- Cross-protocol disagreement is a source-conditional quantity, not experimental truth.
- With only two protocols, only the disagreement and a computational center are identifiable.
- PULSE predicts source-conditional tensor distributions; it does not claim a single true tensor.

## Forbidden claims
- 'true tensor' or 'ground truth consensus' without a third protocol or experiment.
- Averaging JARVIS + MP and calling it physical truth.
- Architecture-level leaderboard superiority on random splits alone.

## Uncertainty layers
- Representation uncertainty (cell, frame, Voigt, shear, unit, symmetry)
- Structure uncertainty (relaxed cell / space group)
- Protocol uncertainty (functional, pseudopotential, DFPT implementation)
- Version uncertainty (database rebuilds, symmetrization)
- Model uncertainty (data, architecture, optimization)
